notes.title: Game Update 20250829
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Shortened the duration of the Mark animation
 Fixed an issue where certain events could not be completed
 Fixed a bug where replacing Mark cards during events caused incorrect card replacements
[/olist]

notes.title: 20250819 Update
notes.notes:
Optimizations & Fixes

 Added a circular progress bar when holding down on enemies, making it easier to see how long it takes to open the Codex.
 Enhanced the 4th skills of Ranger and Bard.
 Fixed an issue where using the Mask of Agony could cause the game to crash under certain circumstances.
 Temporarily hid the Prince’s craftable equipment from the Workshop.

notes.title: Game Update 20250816
notes.notes:
Optimization & Fixes:
Added the option to adjust game settings directly in battle scenes.

Fixed an issue where defeating certain bosses would not grant achievements.
